sources.title: CartPole
sources.snippet: Try to balance the pole yourself in HUMAN mode, or switch to AI AGENT to train a reinforcement learning algorithm to do it automatically. Pick an algorithm, hit TRAIN AGENT, and watch it learn over hundreds of episodes.

sources.title: sb3/dqn-CartPole-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a DQN agent playing CartPole-v1 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
